codes.meaning: A floating-point semantic value was supplied.
Two SET members have identical canonical bytes.
The contract contains a field not permitted by its schema.
An array-valued contract field lacks SET, MULTISET, or ORDERED_SEQUENCE semantics.
A declared digest does not equal the domain-separated digest of canonical bytes.
The object does not satisfy its exact versioned schema.
A reducer-facing receipt does not have validation_result=ACCEPTED.
validated_at_tick does not identify an available committed context.
The raw event cannot be resolved by raw_event_digest.
The validation policy cannot be resolved by validation_policy_digest.
The signature set cannot be resolved by signature_set_digest.
proposed_sequence is not previous_committed_sequence + 1.
The committed head changed before the no-clobber claim could be installed.
A conflicting successor claim already exists for the same committed head.
A projection ran without all required predecessor receipts.
The semantic projection failed and the tick must remain uncommitted.
An entity event sequence is not contiguous.
previous_entity_event_digest does not match the committed predecessor.
Identical validated events produced different registry roots.
The disposition layer attempted to modify substantive semantic state.
A RAP output asserted external truth or model completeness.
A graph difference was detected without an accepted relevance certificate.
The consumer context predates the current quarantine epoch.
The asset is quarantined at or before the current epoch.
Current eligibility cannot be reconstructed and operational use fails closed.
The release request does not reference a completed snapshot.
The requested release class exceeds maximum_reuse_class.
Promotion did not use evidence current at the promotion-request snapshot.
Quarantine advanced or an input became ineligible before publication.

change_rule: Codes are append-only within version 1. Renaming or changing meaning requires a new registry version.
